# Miniature Paper Worlds

> Printable paper dioramas, miniature worlds and creative school projects.

Products are digital templates to print, cut and assemble. Refer to the product pages and linked shops for current prices and contents. The water cycle photo tutorial is free to read; its printable PDF template is sold separately.
